name: M3_PMS100MI_TriggerJob
description: Trigger automatic background jobs based on a transaction name and batch job number. This operation starts an “autojob” that processes pre-created job records linked to a specific batch job. The transaction name field selects which job definition to run; the batch job number field selects which job records to process. Currently, the only supported transaction name is **SplitMO**, which triggers the manufacturing order split process (MO Split in PMS056) for all records tied to the given batch job number.

inputParameters.name: TRXN
inputParameters.description: Name of the PMS100MI transaction whose autojob should be triggered (currently SplitMO).

inputParameters.name: BJNO
inputParameters.description: Batch job number identifying which autojob records to process for the specified transaction.
